name: track-for-git
description: A calm, real-time dashboard of your organisation's GitHub activity: every commit, push and pull request, who made it (and with which AI agent), what changed and what shipped. Self-hosted on Cloudflare Workers + D1, or Node.
author: Qder AI (https://qder.ai)

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

GITHUB_ORG.description: Your GitHub organisation's login, for example `acme`. Leave empty with `DEMO=1`.

AUTH.description: Who may open the dashboard: `access` (Cloudflare Access, recommended), `github` (members of the organisation sign in with GitHub) or `none` (only for a private network or the demo).

DEMO.description: `1` shows a made-up organisation so you can try it before connecting GitHub. Remove it when you connect yours.

GITHUB_APP_ID.description: Your GitHub App's ID (recommended; read-only). See [docs/setup.md](https://github.com/qderai/track-for-git/blob/main/docs/setup.md).

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: The App's private key (the whole `.pem` file).

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Instead of an App: a fine-grained token, read-only (Contents, Metadata, Pull requests, Deployments, Commit statuses; Members for teams).

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: The secret of the webhook (App or organisation), for real-time updates. A long random string.

GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: With `AUTH=github`: the OAuth client ID (the GitHub App's own works).

SESSION_SECRET.description: With `AUTH=github`: 32+ random characters that sign the session cookie.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: With `AUTH=access`: your Zero Trust team domain, for example `acme.cloudflareaccess.com`.

ACCESS_AUD.description: With `AUTH=access`: the Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application.
